To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Industrial Ethernet is a promising technology to connect devices in automation environments.
“Industrial Ethernet systems are a promising approach to solve the problems of real-time data transmission in automation systems.

“the Industrial Ethernet systems PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and SERCOS III are most suitable for industrial automation environments, whereas EtherCAT and Powerlink are more suitable for special applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the current state of the art in the area of real-time communication via Ethernet for industrial automation environments.
an overview of different approaches to real-time communication via Ethernet in industrial automation environments.
the question of which real-time communication protocol is most promising for industrial applications in the future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is not a single Industrial Ethernet protocol, which is superior to all others with regard to all aspects.
the current state of the art in the field of Industrial Ethernet does not allow for a final conclusion.
no single solution is the best solution for all applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is no one-fits-all protocol for the real-time communication over Ethernet.
the most important Industrial Ethernet protocols are PROFINET IO, EtherNet/IP, and Ethernet Powerlink.
the Industrial Internet of Things will not work without a standardized and open real-time capable Ethernet.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Industrial Internet will require new approaches to the design of real-time communication in automation environments.
a new generation of Industrial Ethernet systems is needed, which is capable of handling the upcoming challenges of the “Industrial Internet”.
the Industrial Ethernet systems are not only suitable to replace fieldbuses but also for the integration of the automation systems into the Internet of Things.
